title: Coffee Date
logline: Arjun aur Meera ki pehli coffee date, aur ek chhoti si galatfehmi.
moral: Sach bolne se rishte aur mazboot hote hain.

scenes.summary: Arjun waits outside the cafe; Meera arrives.

beats.hindi: सात बज गए, मीरा अभी तक नहीं आई।
beats.hinglish: Saat baj gaye, Meera abhi tak nahi aayi.
beats.english: It's seven, Meera hasn't come yet.

beats.hindi: सॉरी अर्जुन! ट्रैफिक बहुत ज़्यादा था।
beats.hinglish: Sorry Arjun! Traffic bahut zyada tha.
beats.english: Sorry Arjun! The traffic was terrible.

beats.hindi: कोई बात नहीं। चलो, अंदर चलते हैं।
beats.hinglish: Koi baat nahi. Chalo, andar chalte hain.
beats.english: No problem. Come, let's go inside.

beats.hindi: गुड इवनिंग! क्या लाऊँ आपके लिए?
beats.hinglish: Good evening! Kya laaun aapke liye?
beats.english: Good evening! What can I get you?

beats.hindi: अर्जुन, तुम आज कुछ परेशान लग रहे हो।
beats.hinglish: Arjun, tum aaj kuch pareshan lag rahe ho.
beats.english: Arjun, you look a bit worried today.

beats.hindi: सच कहूँ? मेरी नौकरी चली गई है।
beats.hinglish: Sach kahoon? Meri naukri chali gayi hai.
beats.english: To be honest? I lost my job.

beats.hindi: तो तुमने मुझे पहले क्यों नहीं बताया?
beats.hinglish: Toh tumne mujhe pehle kyun nahi bataya?
beats.english: Then why didn't you tell me earlier?

beats.hindi: डर था कि तुम मिलना बंद कर दोगी।
beats.hinglish: Darr tha ki tum milna band kar dogi.
beats.english: I was afraid you'd stop meeting me.

beats.hindi: पागल! मैं नौकरी से नहीं, तुमसे मिलती हूँ।
beats.hinglish: Pagal! Main naukri se nahi, tumse milti hoon.
beats.english: Silly! I meet you, not your job.

beats.hindi: थैंक यू मीरा। ये शहर की बेस्ट कॉफ़ी है।
beats.hinglish: Thank you Meera. Ye shehar ki best coffee hai.
beats.english: Thank you Meera. This is the best coffee in town.
